events.description: A man in a brown jacket is held at gunpoint by multiple armed men while another man (in green uniform) is bound and raised with ropes, screaming; the victim shows visible injuries and distress across multiple frames.

verification.reason: The man in brown is surrounded, restrained (hands on weapon but not firing), and subjected to threats with rifles pointed at him; simultaneously, another man is suspended by ropes, bleeding, and screaming—consistent with coercive abuse of helpless individuals, not mutual combat or riot. Merged because all candidates describe overlapping coercive acts against captives within the same scene sequence.

events.description: A man in a brown jacket is held at gunpoint by multiple armed individuals, screaming and crying (f3–f12), then transitions to forced smiling while still surrounded by weapons (f13–f17).

verification.reason: The victim is restrained and threatened with firearms; his expressions shift from terror to coerced compliance, consistent with abuse (aggression against a helpless person). The presence of multiple guns pointed at him and his lack of resistance confirm non-consensual coercion.

events.description: A man in green uniform fires a rifle from prone position behind straw cover (f18–f22), with visible muzzle flash and recoil motion in f21–f22.

verification.reason: In f21 and f22, the rifle is raised, muzzle is oriented forward, and the shooter’s body shows recoil posture; dust is kicked up near muzzle in f21, indicating discharge. This satisfies 'Shooting' (visible shooting), distinct from mere weapon possession.
